title: Confirmatory poisoning and empirical privacy-attack evaluation

dataset.name: PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2019
dataset.test_partition_access: prohibited; poisoning uses disjoint validation/outcome partitions and privacy attacks use train/validation only

one_round_poisoning.compatibility_boundary: Only weighted mean is CKKS sum-only compatible; all geometry-based defenses are assumption-mismatched comparators.

privacy_attacks.cohort_size_basis: Locked validation set contains 439 positives; label matching selects 439 positive plus 1000 negative records per group, then a disjoint half is reserved for calibration.
privacy_attacks.membership_attack: label-matched loss score; threshold calibrated on a disjoint half and evaluated on the other half

analysis.interval: two-sided Student-t 95 percent confidence interval across paired seeds
analysis.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within each endpoint family; raw condition-level results retained
analysis.missing_seed_policy: no confirmatory security inference until every registered seed/component cell passes schema and hash validation
analysis.claim_boundary: Empirical attacks cannot prove DP or cryptographic security; results quantify the registered attacks under this dataset and threat model.
